method: Rechecked the current Anthropic PDF support documentation and reran seven offline assertions. The synthetic same-PDF harness was exercised through fake SDK/PDF libraries; validator tests now include malformed containers, non-string, NaN/Infinity values, and invalid totals; exact-JSON scoring rejects duplicate keys; every Python fence fits the 88-character article line-width check. No provider request was made.
limitations: The 2026-10-08 DeepSeek summary has no per-call request/response, exact endpoint/model fingerprint, full usage, or scorer and was not reproduced. The legacy image and text routes were not equivalent transformations of the same PDF.

The fake SDK and fake PDF libraries validate local harness control flow and fixtures only; they do not validate real PDF rendering/extraction, current SDK/provider compatibility, endpoint capabilities, model quality, usage, cost, latency, or billing.

Anthropic documentation establishes behavior for the documented Anthropic API scope only; it does not establish compatibility for third-party endpoints or other providers. Invoice arithmetic is a deliberately simplified fixture and does not encode taxes, discounts, rounding, or other real business rules.
